Esimerkkejä ominaisuuksista ovat muoto, paino, pituus, väri. Ominaisuuden instanssi (esim. tietty punaisuuden sävy) voi olla läsnä useassa objektissa samanaikaisesti.

Properties define objects, events and action. They are not present as independent entities but can be realised in other entities. Examples of properties are shape, weight, height, and colour. An instance of a given property (e.g. a particular shade of red) can be present in several objects simultaneously.
